requirements.title: Reservar material para unas fechas
requirements.statement: WHEN a socio without pending fine requests a material item for a start and an end date and a unit is free on every day of that range THE system SHALL create the reservation and show it in the socio's reservations

criteria.text: GIVEN there are 3 "Piolet" units, all free, and today is 2026-11-21 WHEN "lucia" reserves "Piolet" from 2026-12-05 to 2026-12-07 THEN the user sees "Reserva creada: Piolet, 2026-12-05 a 2026-12-07" and "Piolet" shows "2 libres" for those dates

requirements.title: Ver y cancelar mis reservas
requirements.statement: WHEN a socio opens their reservations THE system SHALL list only their own reservations, and WHEN the socio cancels one whose start date is after today THE system SHALL cancel it and free the unit

criteria.text: GIVEN "lucia" has "Piolet" 2026-12-05 to 2026-12-07 and "pablo" has "Casco" 2026-12-06 to 2026-12-07 WHEN "lucia" opens "Mis reservas" THEN the user sees "Piolet" and does not see "Casco"

tests.name: FASE-1 Mis reservas (socio) › FASE-1 AC-006-01 lucia con Piolet y pablo con Casco: lucia abre Mis reservas y ve Piolet sin Casco
